state:
**Side goal `fmt-layout-from-breaks`, stage 2 partly landed.** `nvs fmt` now lays out a call's arguments (`Call`, `MethodCall`, `StaticCall`, `new`), an array literal and an anonymous object as one line or one item per line, chosen by a break at the list's own level (`crates/nvs-fmt/src/list.rs`, held by `crates/nvs-fmt/tests/list_layout.rs`). The trailing comma follows `List::broken` for those lists (`crates/nvs-fmt/src/tokens.rs`). The corpus is reformatted to the new layout in its own commit.

Not yet a list: parameter lists, enum case lists and shape types, because their node ends somewhere other than the list's closer. `match` arms keep their own rule. The rule `rule:tooling/fmt-a-list-is-one-line-or-one-item-per-line` stays `designed` until those land.

items.text: **A parameter list is a list** — find the `(` … `)` of a `Function`, `Method` and `Fn` signature from its parameter children and add it to `List::of` (`rule:tooling/fmt-a-list-is-one-line-or-one-item-per-line`) — `crates/nvs-fmt/src/list.rs:65`

**An enum's case list is a list** — broken: Allman brace and one case per line; on one line: `{` stays on the `enum` line with one space inside each brace (`rule:tooling/fmt-base-style-is-per`) — `crates/nvs-fmt/src/brace.rs:50`

**Add a `tests/fmt/` pair for lists** (`tests/fmt/input/lists.nvs` and its formatted twin), and drop the old closer-only comma test in `crates/nvs-fmt/src/tokens.rs:114` once every list is `List::of`'s

backlog: `bun nv verify`'s extension step fails in this worktree because `editors/*/node_modules` is absent (no `vscode` or `@types/node`); every Rust step was green. Install the extension's packages here, or the run needs that step's allowance.
Shape types as lists: a type is no node in the walk, so this needs the type spans first (`crates/nvs-fmt/src/space.rs` module doc names the same gap).
Stage 3, call chains and operator chains: `rule:tooling/fmt-a-broken-call-chain-is-one-call-per-line`, `rule:tooling/fmt-a-broken-operator-chain-is-one-operand-per-line`.

An item's own continuation lines keep the author's column when the item moves; `rule:tooling/fmt-never-reflows` says they keep "the indentation of the line it continues", which would shift them with it.
ADR 0267's `fn(User $user) {` example does not parse; the rule fragment now says `fn(User $user): string => {`, and the record is frozen.
